headword: {連帯|れんたい}{保証人|ほしょうにん}
reading: れんたいほしょうにん

definitions.explanation: A person who agrees to take on the same level of responsibility as the primary debtor or tenant, often required for apartment rentals or loans in Japan.

examples.japanese: {連帯|れんたい}{保証人|ほしょうにん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つからない→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: I can't find a joint guarantor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{賃貸|ちんたい}→賃貸：06081_chintai⟧⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{連帯|れんたい}{保証人|ほしょうにん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: A joint guarantor is required for the rental contract.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{連帯|れんたい}{保証人|ほしょうにん}になって⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had my parents become my joint guarantors.

notes:
{連帯|れんたい}{保証人|ほしょうにん} is commonly required when renting apartments in Japan. The guarantor has the same legal obligation as the tenant to pay rent. For those without a suitable guarantor, ⟦{保証|ほしょう}→保証：03718_hoshou⟧{会社|がいしゃ} (guarantor companies) offer an alternative.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連帯|れんたい}{保証人|ほしょうにん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become a joint guarantor)
- {連帯|れんたい}{保証人|ほしょうにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (to provide a joint guarantor)
- {連帯|れんたい}{保証人|ほしょうにん}⟦{不要|ふよう}→不要：02527_fuyou⟧ (no guarantor required)
